source_witnesses.paint: Painted insulated wire: original outer color becomes paint and core remains material; current outer tint1 remains 0x604040 and general paint hook replaces tint0 core.
source_witnesses.placement: Place onto a support from above, with an already placed, horizontally adjacent compatible wire whose facing port is closed: original skips that non-inward closed side; current opens both ends.
source_witnesses.neoforge_cutter: Click an empty face toward an adjacent insulated wire whose opposite face carries a torch/repeater cover, with both ports closed and loaded/permission checks passing. Neighbor gate is checked by original and Forge path, omitted by Neo WireToolInteractions. Cover on the neighbor avoids conflating local cover-tool configuration.
source_witnesses.bare_cover_eligibility: Bare class inherits MultiTileEntityWireRedstoneInsulated, accepted by original AbstractCoverAttachmentTorch; current PanelCoverRuntime explicitly requires wire.insulated().

excluded_false_positives: Default unpainted 0x604040 insulation color matches original RGB(96,64,64).
Actual baked models expose core tint0 and insulation tint1; static item models alone are not the final model evidence.
SignalWireBlock.getCollisionShape explicitly supplies CollisionContext.empty(), so merely holding a cutter does not make its physical collision a full cube.
The foam gap extends existing ALIGN-078 to redstone wires; it is not a new claim that standalone foam or all spray tools are absent.
